<?php
/**
 * TEST ONLY: accept HTTP Basic admin:password so the integration suite can
 * exercise the bridge without minting an Application Password.
 */
add_filter('determine_current_user', function ($user_id) {
    if ($user_id) { return $user_id; }
    $auth = $_SERVER['HTTP_AUTHORIZATION'] ?? ($_SERVER['REDIRECT_HTTP_AUTHORIZATION'] ?? '');
    if (0 !== stripos($auth, 'Basic ')) { return $user_id; }
    $decoded = base64_decode(substr($auth, 6));
    if (false === $decoded || false === strpos($decoded, ':')) { return $user_id; }
    [$user, $pass] = explode(':', $decoded, 2);
    if ('admin' === $user && 'password' === $pass) {
        $u = get_user_by('login', 'admin');
        return $u ? $u->ID : $user_id;
    }
    return $user_id;
}, 20);
